deleteButtonBlockTip: This cannot be undone: the button block is removed from the document.
deleteButtonBlockFailed: The delete failed; see the console for details (turn on Debug mode)
deleteTopBarButtonTip: This cannot be undone: the quick action disappears from the top bar menu and its data file is deleted.
deleteTopBarButtonFailed: The delete failed; see the console for details (turn on Debug mode)
actionContentRequired: Fill in the link address or the JavaScript code
linkAddressTip: Any link works: http(s), siyuan://blocks/<block ID>, assets/<asset path>, mailto: and other protocols registered on the system; it opens exactly like a link inside a document.
scriptCodeTip: Runs when the button is clicked. Use return for a result, await is supported, and console output shows up in the dialog.
scriptFileTip: A local script lives under data/assets/ (the asset directory) or under the plugin's data/storage/petal/button-in-siyuan/scripts/ directory, always named by its path from the workspace root; it is read again on every click. An http(s) address is downloaded again on every click, so the script changes whenever that file does.
scriptFileInvalidName: Invalid file name: it cannot contain ~ [ ] ( ) ! ` & { } = # % $ ; ' / \ : * ? " < > |, or exceed 180 bytes
scriptFileExists: A file with that name already exists at the target location
scriptFileNeeded: Pick a .js file under one of the script directories first (data/assets/ or the plugin's scripts/)
scriptFileFailed: The file operation failed; see the console for details (turn on Debug mode)
cloudWarningTitle: Loading JavaScript from the web may be unsafe
cloudWarningTip: This code comes from the web and can be changed by anyone without you noticing, while a click on the button may read and write your notes. You can give up, or download it into data/assets/ first and use that copy — once downloaded, the button has nothing to do with the web file any more.
cloudDownloadFailed: The download failed; check that the address is reachable
scriptDocsFailed: The documentation cannot be opened right now
scriptUnavailable: This button block is not available in the current environment; the JavaScript was not run
settingsOutputModeTip: When the result dialog opens after a script runs. "With output" is the behaviour the plugin always had: it opens when there is console output, a return value or an error.
settingsDebugModeTip: Off by default: turns on the plugin's own logs (loading, dialogs, failures and other details) in the SiYuan console, and the script's console.debug output (in the console and in the result dialog). Off means the plugin prints nothing, leaving the console to the script's own output
settingsCodeWrapTip: When enabled, content that exceeds the editor width wraps automatically. "Follow SiYuan" (the default) follows SiYuan's "Code block wraps" setting
settingsCodeLigaturesTip: When enabled, the editor shows ligatures (the code font has to bring them). "Follow SiYuan" (the default) follows SiYuan's "Code block ligature" setting
settingsAgentSkill: Provide the button block skill to the agent
settingsAgentSkillTip: Writes a skill explaining how button blocks work (payload format, icon list, script APIs) into the workspace skill directory for SiYuan's agent; switching it off deletes that skill
settingsDownloadSkillTip: Save the whole skill (SKILL.md and its references) as a zip file, to hand it to another agent
downloadSkillFailed: The download failed, see the console for details (turn on Debug mode)
settingsSaveFailed: The settings could not be saved, please retry
manageButtonBlocksTip: List every button block in the workspace in a separate window, search by text, address or script path, preview one and edit it in place
managerSearchPlaceholder: Search button text, links, script paths or documents
managerSelectHint: Pick a button block on the left to preview it
managerLoadFailed: Reading the button blocks failed; see the console for details (turn on Debug mode)
topBarManagerTip: Each quick action is one JSON file under data/storage/petal/button-in-siyuan/topbar/; the menu follows file name order. Actions work like button blocks, and only the text, the icon and the action are editable — the colour cannot be changed.
topBarManagerEmpty: No quick action yet: use the add icon in the corner, or drop a JSON file into that directory
topBarSaveFailed: The save failed; see the console for details (turn on Debug mode)
topBarLoadFailed: Reading the quick actions failed; see the console for details (turn on Debug mode)
blockNotEditable: The button block cannot be edited right now
readonlyPreviewTip: This note is locked and cannot be edited
discardChangesTip: Closing now leaves the button block as it is; this edit is lost.
